title: sites/<slug>/checks.json
description: Site fixtures for engine/tools/check.mjs and the type pack's check sections: what the checks used to hardcode for one site. Every key is optional where the check can derive it from site.config.json (storage prefix, currency words); the rest name pages, games and selectors of this site.

storagePrefix.description: Prefix of every localStorage/sessionStorage key the site writes, separator included ("oql." for "oql.wallet"). Default: site.config.json storagePrefix + ".".

currency.description: The play currency's words as the pages print them. Default: site.config.json currency.

embedHost.description: Regular expression for the hostname of the third-party embed the stage loads (stubbed in the checks, refused elsewhere). Omit when the site embeds nothing.

embedLabel.description: How a check line names the embed host ("*.pragmaticplay.net"). Omit to skip the 'nothing requested from the embed host' line.

stageSelector.description: CSS selector of the embed stage on a demo page.

demoPages.description: Pages with an embed stage that the stage section walks through (Play, Close, the lobby message, a break).

demo.description: A demo game page (stage failures, breaks, the age lock, axe with the stage ready).

demoAfterReject.description: The demo page opened after 'Reject all'.

demoBar.description: A second demo page whose stage bar is compared with the home page's.

offlineLanding.description: The page a visitor lands on in the offline section.

offlineUnvisited.description: A page the visitor never opened, in a build with the embeds on.

offlineUnvisitedNoDemos.description: The same, in a build with the embeds off.

games.description: Our own games, one per engine id: the page is /games/<slug>/ and the root [data-game="<slug>"] unless given.

result.description: Regular expression a finished spin's result line matches.

settled.description: Regular expression a settled spin's result line matches (reduced motion).

colourBet.description: data-bet of an even-money colour bet.

groups.description: The lobby's groups in order (slots first, tables second): the section id and how the nav and the dock name it.

images.description: engine/tools/make-images.mjs: the game slugs fanned out on the home share cards (demos on, and our own games only).

extraPages.description: Routes outside the sitemap that the pages section also loads.
